purpose: Starter LOCATION and GENRE Dream records for the Serendipity theme picker. These are authored seed ingredients only; no live database write is performed by this file.

locations.title: The Lantern Market Between Raindrops
locations.description: A midnight bazaar that appears only during soft rain, where every stall sells a memory, a map, or a tiny impossible tool.
locations.flavorText: Paper lanterns bloom in puddles like moons. Somewhere, a vendor knows the exact price of your next brave choice.

locations.title: The Library Under the Old Redwood
locations.description: A root-woven archive beneath an ancient tree, tended by moth librarians and shelves that rearrange themselves around the reader's needs.
locations.flavorText: The stairs smell like rain and cedar. The book you need is already open, but it is pretending not to know you.

locations.title: The Station at the Edge of Morning
locations.description: A glowing train platform suspended between night and sunrise, where departures are announced as riddles and arrivals change the weather.
locations.flavorText: The timetable flickers. Track seven is boarding for a place you promised yourself you would someday become.

locations.title: The Glasshouse of Friendly Ghosts
locations.description: A warm botanical conservatory where translucent caretakers grow impossible flowers from unfinished conversations.
locations.flavorText: Condensation beads on the panes. A ghost in gardening gloves offers you a blossom that hums your name.

locations.title: The Moonlit Repair Shop for Broken Magic
locations.description: A cluttered workshop tucked behind an alley moonbeam, full of cracked wands, tarnished wishes, dented familiars, and patient robot apprentices.
locations.flavorText: Every drawer contains a second chance. The bell above the door rings only when someone is ready to try again.

genres.title: Cozy Mystery with Teeth
genres.description: A gentle investigation with warm drinks, strange clues, and one sharp little truth hiding under the rug.
genres.flavorText: Nobody is in danger, probably. Still, the teacup has fingerprints, and the cat refuses to look at the fireplace.

genres.title: Hopepunk Space Fable
genres.description: A star-bright tale where kindness is a technology, communities patch the impossible together, and small repairs matter.
genres.flavorText: The engine is failing, the nebula is singing, and the crew has decided that nobody gets left as background radiation.

genres.title: Whimsical Gothic Errand
genres.description: A velvet-shadowed quest of haunted manners, adorable omens, candlelit corridors, and one surprisingly practical to-do list.
genres.flavorText: The ravens are unionized, the castle is emotionally complicated, and your appointment with destiny is running twelve minutes late.

genres.title: Mythic Pacific Northwest
genres.description: A foggy modern legend of redwoods, tides, roadside diners, local spirits, and ordinary people making sacred decisions.
genres.flavorText: The ocean keeps secrets in its coat pockets. The forest knows, but it wants to see whether you ask politely.

genres.title: Robot Fairytale Slice of Life
genres.description: A gentle everyday fantasy where helpful machines, tiny rituals, and domestic magic turn ordinary chores into character growth.
genres.flavorText: The kettle has opinions, the broom is dramatic, and the little robot in the corner has prepared a quest called Tuesday.
